title.narrative: Provision of essential EiE recovery supports for population affected by Cyclone Mocha impacts in 3 townships of Kachin State in Myanmar

description.narrative:
ltpgtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtSchools alt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtnd early childhood care and development centers in the project targeted remote and hard to reach areas and villages in Mansi, Moe guang, and Moe Nyin townships already have pre-existing education and early childhood learning needs and extremely limited resources to provide safe, inclusive, and quality education to the children.lt/spangtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgt
lt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gtThe project will address some of the most dire education needs and gaps of the targeted population from remote villages in 3 townships in Kachin State by implementing the following EiE activities that are also prioritized in the allocation strategy and by the education cluster. The Project will provide for the learning spaces that have been affected or deteriorated by Cyclone Mocha impacts the needed support for emergency repair and improvement to establish or rehabilitate education infrastructure including establishing and rehabilitation of school WASH infrastructures.lt/pgtltpgt
lt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gtIt will provide school furniture (desks, mats, whiteboards/chalkboards, etc.), teaching materials and online learning resources, student learning materials (student kits textbooks for students from the most vulnerable households and for students with disabilities, student recreational kits, school stationeries, monthly incentives to recruited teachers, and menstrual health and hygiene management materials support (sanitary pads) for adolescent girls in learning centers.ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gtNumber of people that will be reached with education supports from this project is estimated as 8620 people (1000F, 3600girls, 320M, 3700 boys from schools in villages that are remote and most acutely affected by the impacts of Cyclone Mocha, conflicts, or crisis in ltspan style="background-image: initial background-position: initial background-size: initial background-repeat: initial background-attachment: initial background-origin: initial background-clip: initial"gtMan si, Mogaung, and Mohnyin townshipslt/spangt in Kachin State. Project will help the affected population gain needed EiE recovery assistance and improves access to safe and quality education for the children.lt/pgtltpgt
